WHERE LEARNING TAKES A BREAK
School Picnic
DISCOVER
Welcome to Manas Lifestyle Resort – Best Resort in Igatpuri for School Picnics
Looking for a safe, spacious and fun-filled destination for your school picnic? Manas Lifestyle Resort in Igatpuri is a trusted choice for schools across Mumbai, Thane, Nashik and nearby cities. Surrounded by the green Sahyadri hills, our resort gives students a refreshing break from the classroom, with open lawns, a swimming pool, games, delicious food and a supportive team that looks after every detail.
Every year, we host more than 80 school picnics, including many large and well-known schools that visit us with big groups. This experience helps us manage hundreds of students at a time, smoothly and safely, so teachers can relax and children can enjoy a day they will remember.
From the moment your buses arrive to the moment they leave, our team takes care of welcome, seating, activities, meals and supervision support. Whether it is a one-day outing or an overnight trip, we make your school picnic simple to plan and joyful to experience.

Why Choose Manas Lifestyle Resort for Your School Picnic?
80+ School Picnics a Year
Trusted by many big schools, we have the experience to handle large student groups with ease and care.
Largest Banquet and Open Spaces
Spacious banquet halls and wide lawns let hundreds of students gather, play and eat comfortably.
Fun-Filled Activities
Swimming pool, rain dance, arcade zone, wooden games, indoor games, sports and creative activities keep every age group engaged.
Safe and Student-Friendly
A secure campus, trained staff and clean surroundings give teachers and parents complete peace of mind.
Tasty, Hygienic Meals
Fresh breakfast, lunch, snacks and evening tea with menus planned for children, including vegetarian options.
Customisable Packages
Choose a package that matches your school's group size, budget, duration and activity preferences.

FAQs
Q1. What is the minimum and maximum group size for a school picnic?
We host groups of all sizes, from small classes to several hundred students at a time. Share your numbers and we will confirm availability.
Q2. Do you offer one-day and overnight picnics?
Yes. We offer both one-day picnics and overnight trips for schools.
Q3. What meals are included?
Packages usually include breakfast, lunch and evening tea with snacks. Menus are kid-friendly and can be customised.
Q4. Is the resort safe for children?
Yes. We have a secure campus, trained staff and supervised activity areas. Teachers stay in charge of their students, and our team supports them throughout.
Q5. How far is Manas Lifestyle Resort from Mumbai?
We are located on Mumbai Agra Highway, Talegaon, Igatpuri, Nashik, around 120 km from Mumbai, making it a convenient day-trip destination.
Q6. Is there parking for school buses?
Yes, we have ample parking space for multiple buses.
Q7. How can I book a school picnic?
Call our corporate and group desk on 9850002245 or email sales@manaslifestyleresort.in with your school name, date, group size and requirements.

Where is Manas Lifestyle Resort located?
Manas Lifestyle Resort, one of the best resorts in Igatpuri, is located on the Mumbai–Nashik Highway in Talegaon, Igatpuri, Nashik District, Maharashtra. Its prime location makes it a perfect weekend getaway from Mumbai and Nashik.
Why is Manas Lifestyle Resort known as the best resort in Igatpuri?
Our resort is famous for its unique fog experience, where mist drifts inside your room, creating a dreamy atmosphere. Combined with luxury villas, banquet halls, and multicuisine dining, it is regarded as one of the best luxury resorts in Igatpuri.
How far is the resort from Mumbai and Nashik?
We are 120 km (2.5 hours) from Mumbai and only 40 km (40 minutes) from Nashik, making us a popular choice for the best resort near Mumbai and Nashik.
What types of rooms and villas are available?
We offer a wide range of accommodations, including luxury rooms, suites, and villas (2BHK to 15BHK). Perfect for couples, families, and groups, we are among the top Igatpuri resorts for family and group stays.
Is Manas Lifestyle Resort family-friendly?
Yes, it is regarded as the best resort in Igatpuri for families. With kids’ activities, lawns, a swimming pool, and multicuisine dining, families enjoy a safe and fun-filled stay.
Is the resort couple-friendly?
Absolutely! Our rooms and villas make us one of the most popular resorts in Igatpuri for couples, offering privacy and romance.
Does Manas Lifestyle Resort have a swimming pool?
Yes, our resort features a well-maintained swimming pool and a rain dance, making it one of the best resorts in Igatpuri with swimming pools.
What dining options are available?
We are among the highly rated multicuisine restaurants in Igatpuri, serving Indian, Continental, and local delicacies. Guests especially love our buffets and à la carte menu.
Is outside food allowed at the resort?
No, outside food and beverages are not permitted. However, our in-house multicuisine restaurant in Igatpuri offers a wide variety of freshly prepared meals.
Does the resort host weddings?
Yes! We are one of the top wedding resorts in Igatpuri, offering banquet halls, lawns, and customizable packages for dream weddings.
What makes Manas Lifestyle Resort ideal for weddings?
We have one of the largest banquet halls in Igatpuri along with open lawns, luxury rooms, and exceptional dining — making us a perfect resort in Igatpuri for weddings.
Can corporate events be hosted here?
Yes, we are widely chosen for corporate outings, conferences, and team-building events. As one of the leading resorts in Igatpuri for corporate events, we provide modern facilities and customizable packages.
Do you provide facilities for office outings near Mumbai?
Yes, Manas Lifestyle Resort is considered the best resort for office outings near Mumbai, with large venues, group activities, and team-friendly accommodations.
What activities can guests enjoy at the resort?
Guests can enjoy indoor games, outdoor sports, arcade games, pot making, rain showers, DJ nights, live singing, and the swimming pool.
Does the resort provide an EV charging station?
Yes! We are one of the few eco-friendly resorts in Igatpuri offering EV charging stations for electric vehicles.
Is the resort pet-friendly?
We love animals, but at present, pets are not permitted inside the resort to maintain hygiene and comfort for all guests.
Which tourist attractions are nearby?
Nearby attractions include Camel Valley, Vipassana Center, Sandhan Valley, Trimbakeshwar Temple, and Igatpuri waterfalls.
What is the best time to visit Manas Lifestyle Resort?
The resort is beautiful year-round, but the monsoon is special when fog and mist cover the property, making it the best resort in Igatpuri during the monsoon.
Does the resort have banquet halls for events?

Resort in Igatpuri Near Mumbai, Pune and Nashik: Distance and Travel Time Guide
Manas Lifestyle Resort is a
resort in Igatpuri
on the Mumbai–Agra Highway in Talegaon, about 120 km and 2.5 hours from Mumbai, and about 40 km (40 minutes) from Nashik. Pune is roughly 230 km away, around 5 hours by road. Thane and Kalyan fall in between, which is why many families treat it as a one-night escape rather than a full holiday. This guide lists the distance and travel time from each major starting point, the best way to reach the resort by road, train or cab, and the sights you will pass on the way. Times are approximate and change with traffic and weather.
Resort in Igatpuri Near Mumbai: Distance and Drive Time From Mumbai, Borivali and Thane
The resort is about 120 km from Mumbai and the drive takes roughly 2.5 hours. The route follows the Mumbai–Nashik highway through Thane and the Shahapur belt, then climbs Kasara Ghat before reaching Igatpuri. Guests starting from the western suburbs such as Malad or Borivali should expect about 125 km, and about 2.5 to 3 hours if traffic is heavy around Thane.
From Thane the distance is close to 100 km and from Kalyan about 90 km, so the drive is usually a little over 2 hours. Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport is around 140 km away, so plan on roughly 3 hours by taxi.
Leaving before 7 a.m. helps you cross Kasara Ghat in clear light and reach check-in with time for the pool. If you prefer a shorter hop, see the
weekend getaway resort near Mumbai
guide, or compare the
best resort near Mumbai
for family and couple stays.
Resort in Igatpuri Near Pune: Distance and Travel Time From Pune
Pune is roughly 230 km from Igatpuri. Intercity cab estimates put the road journey at around 5 hours, though this depends on the route and traffic through the Mumbai side of the ghats. The resort is a little before Igatpuri town if you are arriving from Mumbai, so ask your driver to navigate to Talegaon on the Mumbai–Agra Highway.
By train, most travellers take a Pune to Kalyan service and then continue to Kasara or Igatpuri. Allow 5 to 7 hours in total, including the change at Kalyan, and book a taxi for the last stretch because there is no resort shuttle listed.
Because the trip is long, families from Pune usually book two nights. That leaves a full day for the pool, games and nearby sights instead of spending the whole stay in the car. Larger groups can compare
villas in Igatpuri
that range from 2BHK to 15BHK, and free parking includes space for buses.

Resort in Igatpuri Near Nashik: Distance and Travel Time From Nashik and Kasara
Nashik is the closest major city. The resort is about 40 km from Nashik, a drive of around 40 minutes, and the town of Igatpuri sits roughly 45 km from the city centre. That makes it an easy choice for a same-day outing, a family lunch or a corporate off-site from Nashik.
On the Mumbai side, Kasara is about 20 km from Igatpuri town, and the ghat section between the two is where the road climbs the Western Ghats. Local trains stop at Kasara, so some guests from Mumbai take a train to Kasara and then a taxi uphill.
If you live in Nashik and want to compare options on your side of the district, read about the
best resort near Nashik
. For travellers coming from either city, the guide to the
best resorts in Igatpuri near Mumbai and Nashik
shows how the two routes compare.
Resort in Igatpuri by Train, Bus and Cab: How to Reach Without a Car
Suburban trains from Mumbai end at Kasara, while long-distance trains stop at Igatpuri railway station, so you can pick the option that suits your schedule. A direct journey by rail from Mumbai takes close to 3 hours, and from Thane about 2 to 3 hours, depending on the train.
From either station, a taxi or auto is the simplest way to cover the final stretch. Share the pickup point and arrival time with the team beforehand by calling 9850002234 so they can guide your driver. Buses on the Mumbai–Nashik highway also stop at Igatpuri, and drivers know the resort as a landmark on the highway.
For group trips, a hired coach is easier than several cars, and the resort provides free parking with room for buses. Check what the stay includes by opening the
resort offers in Igatpuri
before you book, and confirm pickup details when you call.
Resort in Igatpuri Nearby Places: What You Can Visit Along the Way
Several sights sit close to the resort. The Bhatsa River Valley lies less than 3 km away, and Camel Valley follows a short distance ahead, where a steep slope drops more than 1,000 ft. Keep behind the railings for photos.
Kasara Ghat is the scenic drive you cross on the way from Mumbai, with mist and waterfalls in the rains. Vihigaon Waterfall, about 120 ft high, is best in the monsoon. The Vipassana International Academy at Dhamma Giri is a meditation centre, so visit quietly. Kalsubai Peak, the highest peak in the Sahyadri range, is around 35 km from Igatpuri and suits early-morning trekkers.
During the monsoon, fog is visible from outside the villas at the resort, which makes mornings on the lawns especially atmospheric. For a full list of stops with timings, use the

guide and the
things to do in Igatpuri
travel guide.
